note: HSBC Malta's fee information document (1 June 2026): a monthly Customer Account Fee of 5 euros, not charged to a minor under 16, or to a customer paying in 2,100 euros over three months (1,250 from 61), receiving a pension or benefit, holding a loan, or new to the bank for six months (none of these modelled, the three-month count not being one the game keeps). Its quarterly minimum balance fee of 10 euros isn't charged after a month the Customer Account Fee was, so it never falls due here.
